messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: prod-gateway (us-east-1) — 5xx spike detected across public API routes. error-rate > 4% sustained for 3m. paging oncall.
Maya Chen: acked. i'm oncall. looking.
Maya Chen: quick check — is this limited to a specific model or route?
Leo Torres: seeing lots of 429s turning into 5xx in the gateway logs. looks like rate limiter is rejecting upstream traffic -> upstream retries-> overload -> 5xx. suspicious.
Maya Chen: can you paste the sample logs, Leo?
Leo Torres: sure. snippet from gw logs:
```
[2026-03-15T18:01:02Z] route=/v1/generate tenant=acme status=429 quota_rule=global_tenant_limit
[2026-03-15T18:01:02Z] route=/v1/generate tenant=acme status=502 upstream=lm-01 connection-reset
[2026-03-15T18:01:03Z] route=/v1/embeddings tenant=acme status=429 quota_rule=global_tenant_limit
```
Samir Patel: I see a recent rollout of a quota rollup policy at ~17:50 that aggregated several tenant allowances into a single global cap. could be misapplied.
Frank Liu: can we confirm config change events around that time? deploy-bot? @deploy-bot? (paging deploy logs)
Maya Chen: @CS Bot can you surface if any enterprise customers reported incidents?
CS Bot: Customer-impact: acme-inc (SLA class Gold) reporting timeouts since ~17:58. multiple error reports from support queue ticket #4742. affecting ~2% of active orgs.
Samir Patel: timeline: quota-rollup v3 -> applied to prod config at 17:49 by infra-cfg pipeline. looks like the new rollup inadvertently folded dedicated tenant buckets into the shared global bucket for a subset of routes.
Maya Chen: mitigation plan: 1) disable quota-rollup v3 (rollback) 2) temporarily increase global token bucket to reduce immediate 429s and upstream retries 3) apply fallback routing to older model variant for high-volume tenants until stable. executing now.
Maya Chen: Step 1: rolling back quota-rollup config.
```
# terraform apply -target=module.quota_rollup -var='env=prod' -auto-approve
# ./scripts/infra-rollback --change-id=cfg-20260315-rollup
```
Maya Chen: Step 2: bumping token bucket to 5x for 10m
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/admin/quota/bump \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"scope":"global","multiplier":5,"ttl_secs":600}'
```
Leo Torres: applied bump, returning success: {"status":"ok","new_rate":50000}
Frank Liu: watch metrics — dashboards show 429 down from 18% -> 1.8% over last 3m, 5xx also trending down. nice.
Maya Chen: Samir, can you run a quick config diff to make sure nothing else weird got toggled?
Samir Patel: on it. diff shows only quota-rollup v3 changed. it added aggregation rules for routes /v1/generate and /v1/chat that included some dedicated-tenant labels. bug is missing label exclusion logic.
Maya Chen: assigning follow-ups: Samir to own PR to add exclusion rule + test harness, Leo to validate gateway retry/backoff settings to prevent retry-amplification, Frank to coordinate with CS and start customer notifications. i'll keep monitoring and will handoff in 20m.
Priya Rao: Maya I'm taking over in 20. please add context on the handoff message so i can continue mitigation.
Maya Chen: handoff notes: rollback completed (cfg-20260315-rollup reverted), temporary token bump applied, 5xx and 429 rates dropping. impacted customers: acme-inc (Gold), betaapps (Silver partial), observed elevated latency for embeddings on eu-west-1 proxies due to fanout in routing.
Maya Chen: retention: we kept traces and full request IDs for 17:45–18:10 window — stored at s3://redwood-incident-logs/prod/3032100000/
Maya Chen: metrics: peak 5xx 7.9% at 17:58; current 0.6% at 18:12. peak 429 22% at 17:55; current 1.2% at 18:12.
Priya Rao: taking over now. noted owners. I'm going to keep token bump for another 10m and then throttle down to 2x until patch merges.
Priya Rao: @CS Bot please prepare templated notification for affected customers (include apology + rollback mention + ETA for follow-up pm).
CS Bot: Draft ready: "We experienced elevated errors affecting API calls between 17:50-18:05 UTC due to an internal quota configuration change. Root cause rollback completed; services returning to normal. Our SREs will follow up with a detailed report." Will add customer-specific IDs.
Leo Torres: we should also harden retry behavior: change gateway to linear backoff + jitter and cap retries for 429->5xx chain. I have a draft PR.
Samir Patel: PR for exclusion logic: https://git.redwood/infra/quota-rollup/pull/112 (draft). tests failing for edge case where tenant label=="dedicated". I'll push fix and request review @Frank Liu.
Frank Liu: ack. once Samir merges, we'll canary apply to prod with a single small tenant and observe for 30m.
Priya Rao: monitoring: enabling extra alerting for quota-change events to automatically page on anomalous 429->5xx fanout.
Maya Chen: thanks team. i'm un-assigning myself from oncall now — Priya will continue monitoring and will escalate to SEV if we see >1% residual customer impact after ramp down.
Priya Rao: will do. leaving summary: root cause: quota-rollup v3 misapplied aggregation rules merging dedicated tenant buckets into shared global cap -> mass 429s -> retry amplification -> gateway upstream 5xx. mitigation: rollback + token bump + planned code fix + retry policy changes. next steps: postmortem owner Samir, ETA draft in 24h. CS follow-ups by Frank. Ops ticket for automated 429->5xx detector by Leo.
Maya Chen: closing on my side — please ping if anything flares. :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: closing channel in 1h unless any regressions. :white_check_mark:
